struck: Houses in an HOA rarely allow nightly rentals.
use: Few houses with an HOA fee say nightly rentals are allowed.

struck: Carolina Forest is outside the cities, where Horry County's zoning sets no limit on how long a home may be rented.
use: Most of them (287) are outside city limits, where Horry County's zoning sets no limit on how long a home may be rented.

struck: The counts use what each listing says, as the listing agent marked it.
use: The counts use the rental flags on each listing.

pattern: \brules?\b[^.]{0,120}\bmust be (?:given|handed|provided|made available|made accessible) to (?:a |any )?(?:member|owner)s? who asks?\b
struck: Its rules take effect when adopted, must be given to a member who asks, and stay enforceable only if recorded by January 10.
use: Rules take effect when adopted. An association must give a member a copy on request unless they are posted in a common area or on its website.

struck: South Carolina law puts no limit on an association's rental rules.
use: Neither South Carolina's HOA Act nor its condo law caps an association's rental rules or exempts owners who bought before a new one.

struck: A condo's master deed barred renting to college students.
use: A Richland County condo's master deed barred renting to college students not related to the owner.

struck: The association had not watched rentals closely before.
use: The court said that even if the association had not watched rentals before, it had not given up the rule.

pattern: \ban owner rented the main floor of his\b
struck: An owner rented the main floor of his house on Airbnb.
use: Owners rented the main floor of their house on Airbnb while living in the guest suite upstairs.

struck: In Florida, a new condo rule that bans or limits renting applies only to owners who agree to it and to later buyers.
use: In Florida, a condo declaration amendment that bans or limits renting binds only owners who agree to it and later buyers.

pattern: \blodging tax\b[^.]{0,160}\bunless the home is rented fewer than 15 days\b
struck: South Carolina charges its lodging tax when a home is rented to the same guest for less than 90 days in a row, unless the home is rented fewer than 15 days in the year.
use: It does not apply to a home rented fewer than 15 days in the year, or to rooms rented in the owner's own home with fewer than six bedrooms.

pattern: \b(?:6|six) (?:of them )?mention rent|\b1 does, and it is about a rental deposit\b|\brental deposit\b
struck: From 2022 to 2025 it logged 1,527 HOA complaints statewide; 6 mention renting. Of 416 from Horry County, 1 does, and it is about a rental deposit.
use: From 2022 to 2025 it logged 1,527 HOA complaints statewide. 9 were about an association's rental rules, and 1 of those came from Horry County.

pattern: \bwaiting period\b[^.]{0,60}\b(?:rent|lease)\b|\bban on renting to a group of tenants\b
struck: a waiting period before a new owner may rent, a ban on renting to a group of tenants
use: (cut the waiting period: no source) a limit on who may rent, such as the Richland County condo's ban on renting to college students not related to the owner

struck: No state bill would change this.
use: Two 2025 bills on short-term rentals, H. 3861 and S. 442, were sent to committee and went no further.

struck: In North Myrtle Beach, 27 of 119 (about 1 in 4) houses for sale with an HOA fee say nightly rentals are allowed.
use: In North Myrtle Beach, 27 of 119 (fewer than 1 in 4) houses for sale with an HOA fee say nightly rentals are allowed.

struck: In Florida, an amendment to a condo declaration that bans or limits renting applies only to owners who vote for it and to later buyers.
use: In Florida, a condo declaration amendment that bans or limits renting applies only to owners who consent to it and to later buyers.

pattern: \b(?:recorded|posted) (?:papers|rules|declarations?|master deeds?|documents)\b[^.]{0,100}\b(?:bans? (?:all )?renting (?:at all|altogether|entirely|outright)|ban on all renting|rental caps?|caps? (?:on )?the number of (?:rented|rental) (?:homes|units))\b
struck: The posted papers we read show every form, from a ban on all renting to a rental cap.
use: (no local document read holds a total ban or a rental cap; those two rest on the owner's stories, rows 27 and 28)

struck: The county maps most of its parcels as boat slips in the harbor.
use: The county lists 78 boat-slip parcels in the Coquina Harbour Marina.

struck: Waterfall, a neighborhood managed from North Myrtle Beach, bans Airbnb.
use: (name Waterfall without a town: its lots are in unincorporated Horry County, outside North Myrtle Beach and Little River)

struck: No unit may be rented until every rental guest registers with the on-site access company and gets a door fob.
use: No unit may be rented until rental guests not staying with the owner register with the on-site access company and the unit's front door has the company's lock and fob system.

struck: An oceanfront tower whose papers allow nightly renting.
use: An oceanfront tower whose master deed allows short stays.

pattern: \bThe Farm\b[^.]{0,80}\b13 amendments\b|\bBerkshire Forest\b[^.]{0,40}\b10 amendments\b|\b\d+ rule sets\b
struck: The Farm at Carolina Forest, 13 amendments to its declaration and 7 rule sets; Berkshire Forest, 10 amendments and 14 rule sets.
use: The Farm at Carolina Forest, 13 amendment filings (its sixth to fifteenth amendments, three numbers filed twice) and 7 rule, policy or design papers; Berkshire Forest, 7 amendments to its declaration, 3 more to side declarations, and 14 rule, policy or design papers.

struck: Since 2019, at least 23 association papers recorded in Horry County carry a title about renting.
use: Since 2019, at least 22 association papers recorded in Horry County carry a title about renting, leasing or renters.

pattern: \bFHA approves a condo project only if\b|\bonly if at least (?:50 percent|half) of its units are owner.occupied\b
struck: FHA approves a condo project only if at least 50 percent of its units are owner-occupied.
use: For FHA approval, at least half of a condo project's units must be owner-occupied; an existing project more than a year old can qualify at 35 percent under extra conditions, and a new one at 30 percent.

pattern: \btwo units in a building of fewer than (?:10|ten)\b|\bfewer than (?:10|ten) units\b[^.]{0,60}\b(?:FHA|two)\b|\bFHA\b[^.]{0,100}\bfewer than (?:10|ten) units\b
struck: FHA does not already insure more than 10 percent of the units (two units in a building of fewer than 10).
use: FHA may stop new loans there once it insures more than 10 percent of the units in a building of 20 or more, or more than two in a smaller one.
